Hi Tom,

Thanks for testing that, and sorry you are having to. Swapping the known-good power supply onto the third unit and getting the same trip settles it: the fault is in the unit, not the brick, and nothing you did caused it. Your RMA form has come through, so nothing more is needed from you there.

Here is what happens next. Your return is with JD and Georges for sign-off, which is the last step before I can buy your prepaid return label and reserve your replacement. The team is offline tonight and picks this up tomorrow from 10am ET. As soon as it is approved I will send you the label and a return reference to write on the outside of the box, and the replacement NerdQaxe++ Rev 5.1 Pro is set aside and ships as soon as your unit reaches our warehouse.

On the first unit that drops offline and reboots, keep it running for now and note roughly how often it happens and whether it is on the same outlet. If it starts tripping the same way, we will fold it into the same return rather than make you do this twice.

You have had a long run of this since September, and I am sorry. I will come back to you in this thread tomorrow with the label.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi Tom,

Of course. Your return is with the team for sign-off and they pick it back up tomorrow from 10am ET, and I will come back to you here as soon as it is confirmed.

In the meantime you can leave the dead unit unplugged, and keep the other two running as they are. If the one that reboots starts tripping the same way before you hear from me, just tell me and I will add it to the same return so you only pack one box.

Sorry again for the run you have had on this order.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi,

The 2 NerdQaxe++ have been running unaffected for 18 hours so far. I
believe connecting them to a different power strip may have done the trick.

Tom

Hi Tom,

Good to hear, and that fits. A shared strip sagging under load will cause exactly those random reboots, so if 18 hours have been clean on a different strip, those two are fine. Worth keeping them on that strip and off anything with a big motor or heater on the same circuit.

The third unit is a separate matter and still a hardware fault, so nothing changes there. The team is reviewing your return now and will confirm it shortly. As soon as it is signed off I will come straight back to you here with the prepaid label and the reference to write on the box, and you will not need to do anything else in the meantime.

Thanks for the update, it helps.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
